title.narrative: Responding Humanitarian assistance for conflict affected people in Kachin State

description.narrative: ltpgtThe humanitarian situation remains challenging with immense acute humanitarian needs in protracted displacement resulted from the 12-year long intensified conflict in Kachin State. The project will ensure Dai Fin Social Services Organization be able to address the needs of IDPs in Waingmaw township and Sadung sub-twonship of Kachin State. Waimaw Township and Sadung sub-Township is within the zone of armed conflict between different armed groups and military regime group. Especially, since Feb 2021, there were frequent clashes occurring between different armed groups and new displacement occurred and it is ongoing process. As result number of IDPs emerged and local resident were difficult to transport and processing livelihood activity. They are facing various poverties and challenges. ltbrgtDai Fin social services (DFSS) targeted Townships are Waimaw and Sadung and its included 3 host communities and 11 IDPs camps. DFSS proposed activities including three sectors: Education, Livelihood, and Protection. These all activities planned to implement the targeted IDPs camp locations and host community’s villages. ltbrgtAccording to the current existing situation and previous project experience, there are significant and submerged cases relating to protection sectors existing in the targeted areas, and gaps of educational related issue such as inadequate of learning material/educational supporting material in both village and IDPs camp. On the other hand, still need to improve livelihood activity for food security in both village and IDPs camps. ltbrgtProtection activity still needs to proceed both in IDPs camp and Community to prevent protection issues and cases throughout awareness raising such as gender violence, abuse, harassment, bully, child abuse, sexual exploitation, and discrimination. Actually, protection regarding sexual abuse, and GBV cases are highly sensitive and difficult to investigate the information even if the information is received. However, awareness raising is the best strategy to improve intervention mechanism of protection sector. ltbrgtAnd there are lacks family supporting in students’ educational supplies and material in both village and IDPs camp especially in IDPs because of the effect of pandemic, political changes, and market prices raising to double and triple price then previous situations and most household could not effort on their students’ educational requirements struggling on their daily family food sufficient. ltbrgtAs well as family livelihoods activity facing various difficulties of limited access to farmland, and other livelihoods activities such as fishing, gathering foods from forest for the risk of conflict such as land mine risk and frequent clashes between different armed group, and warning of armed group. So, one of the project activities supporting MPCA to the beneficiary will be helped for household food security, health, and other household needs, MPCA intended for helping livelihood activity such as home gardening, and other use of all livelihood activities. ltbrgtThe project’s goal reflects Metta and partner's commitment to address gaps and immediate humanitarian needs of people facing temporary and protracted displacement, while pre-positioning capabilities and resources to quickly and effectively respond to urgent needs.ltbrgtThe activities to be undertaken as part of this project include interventions in priority clusters of protection, food security and shelter. Metta will construct shelters for internally displaced people and partner will conduct awareness sessions of GBV,PSEA, MRE, CP for both IDP and host communities. In addition, responding safety audit will be contributed under protection sector and CP kits will also be distributed. Food security sector will also be implemented by partner through supporting cash assistance.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
